tasks.title: [BUG-002] Edit Profile button is a dead tap — does not navigate
tasks.description:
Edit Profile row on Profile screen has a chevron but tapping it does nothing. Users cannot update display name, bio, or any profile info. Fix navigation from profile screen to EditProfileScreen.

Evidence: qa-artifacts/010-edit-profile.png, qa-artifacts/011-edit-profile-retry.png
Build: 8f5c428
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping Edit Profile navigates to edit screen
User can update display name and bio
Changes persist after navigating away

tasks.title: [BUG-009] Average score shows 0.0 despite existing reviews
tasks.description:
Pick Detail screen shows score 0.0 and "0 ratings" even when ratings exist. Individual rating records render in the list below. Aggregation query or v_active_picks view may not be calculating correctly.

Evidence: qa-artifacts/005-pick-detail-blind.png, qa-artifacts/006-pick-detail-scrolled.png
Build: 8f5c428
acceptanceCriteria: Average score reflects existing ratings
Rating count matches actual number of reviews
v_active_picks view calculates aggregates correctly

tasks.title: [BUG-004] Raw PostgrestException shown on invalid invite code
tasks.description:
When user enters invalid invite code, the raw Dart exception leaks to the UI: "Failed to join: PostgrestException(message: Invalid invite code, code: P0001, details: Bad Request, hint: null)". Should show user-friendly message instead.

Evidence: qa-artifacts/017-join-invalid-code.png
Build: 8f5c428
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid invite code shows user-friendly error message
No raw exception details exposed to user
Error is actionable (e.g. "Invalid invite code. Please check and try again.")

tasks.title: [BUG-001] Bio missing from Profile screen
tasks.description:
ProfileScreen shows username, display name, and avatar but bio is not displayed anywhere. Profile screen has "Account" section with Edit Profile and Notifications, but no bio text.

Evidence: qa-artifacts/009-profile-tab.png
Build: 8f5c428
acceptanceCriteria: Bio is displayed on Profile screen
Bio renders correctly even when empty

tasks.title: [BUG-005] League detail screen missing description and members list
tasks.description:
League Detail screen only shows league name and picks list. Description text and members list are not rendered, even though data exists in the database (entered during league creation).

Evidence: qa-artifacts/004-league-detail-test-me.png, qa-artifacts/018-test-me-league-detail.png
Build: 8f5c428
acceptanceCriteria: League description is displayed on detail screen
Members list is displayed on detail screen

tasks.title: [BUG-006] Invite code not visible on League Detail screen
tasks.description:
No invite code is visible on League Detail screen. There is an "Invite to League" icon button in the header, but the invite code itself is not surfaced clearly for copying/sharing.

Evidence: qa-artifacts/018-test-me-league-detail.png
Build: 8f5c428
acceptanceCriteria: Invite code is visible on League Detail screen
User can copy or share the invite code

tasks.title: [BUG-010] Friends screen missing Accepted/Pending tabs
tasks.description:
Friends screen shows only a single empty-state view with no tab bar or segmented control. Spec requires two tabs: Accepted and Pending.

Evidence: qa-artifacts/008-friends-tab.png
Build: 8f5c428
acceptanceCriteria: Friends screen has Accepted tab
Friends screen has Pending tab
Each tab shows correct friend records

tasks.title: [BUG-011] User can find and add themselves as a friend
tasks.description: Friend search results include the current user own profile with an active Add button. Self-friending should be prevented. Evidence: qa-artifacts/026-friend-search-results.png. Build: 8f5c428
acceptanceCriteria: Own profile does not appear in friend search results
Attempting to self-add returns clean error

tasks.title: [BUG-003] League cards missing member count
tasks.description:
LeagueCard shows name, privacy indicator, and frequency but no member count. Spec requires member count to be displayed on each card.

Evidence: qa-artifacts/002-leagues-screen.png
Build: 8f5c428
acceptanceCriteria: LeagueCard displays member count
Member count is accurate

tasks.title: [BUG-007] Picker name and avatar not shown on Pick Detail screen
tasks.description:
Pick Detail screen shows album cover, title, artist, score, dates, Spotify link, and action buttons — but not the picker name or avatar. Picker info IS shown on the pick card in league detail (Picked by BradsHabits) but missing on the expanded detail screen.

Evidence: qa-artifacts/005-pick-detail-blind.png, qa-artifacts/021-pick-detail-blonde.png
Build: 8f5c428
acceptanceCriteria: Pick Detail shows picker name
Pick Detail shows picker avatar

tasks.title: [BUG-008] Genre chips not populated with actual genre data
tasks.description:
Pick Detail genre chips show wrong data: on BLIND pick shows a single chip with user-entered description (not genre), on Blonde pick no chips at all. May be related to Spotify audio-features API deprecation. Need alternative genre data source.

Evidence: qa-artifacts/005-pick-detail-blind.png, qa-artifacts/021-pick-detail-blonde.png
Build: 8f5c428
acceptanceCriteria: Genre chips display real genre data from Spotify or alternative source
No user-entered text displayed as genre

tasks.title: [BUG-012] Long league names heavily truncated in cards and detail header
tasks.description:
Long league names are truncated: card shows "Join me on REalbum Leagu..." and detail header shows "Join me on RE...". The detail screen header has space for more characters or could wrap to two lines.

Evidence: qa-artifacts/001-launch-screen.png, qa-artifacts/004-league-detail-test-me.png
Build: 8f5c428
acceptanceCriteria: Long league names wrap gracefully or are truncated with more characters visible on detail screen
